toolIssues: All three tools returned live data successfully; no auth or script errors. DataForSEO (loc 2124 Canada, en), Ahrefs (country ca, ~1376 units spent across 2 overview calls), and Semrush (database 'ca', phrase_these report) all queried. Methodology notes: (1) consensusVolume = median of the three tools' monthly volume for the bestQuery, treating null as 'no data' (excluded from median) rather than zero. (2) Semrush volumes run systematically HIGHER than Ahrefs/DataForSEO for these geo-modified terms (e.g. Toronto: SR 2900 vs DFS 3600 vs Ahrefs 800; Mississauga: SR 1000 vs DFS 720 vs Ahrefs 400). Ahrefs tends lowest; DataForSEO sits in the middle and is treated as the tie-breaker/anchor for Canada. (3) bestQuery = 'web design {city}' for every city — I tested the company/agency variants for Toronto via Ahrefs ('web design company toronto' 500, 'web design agency toronto' 600, 'toronto web design' 700) and 'web design toronto' (800 Ahrefs / 2900 SR / 3600 DFS) remained highest, so the plain pattern wins everywhere. (4) Ahrefs KD shown in semrushKD? No — Ahrefs KD is in ahrefsKD; Semrush did not return a usable KD column (Kd came back empty in phrase_these export), so semrushKD is null for all rows. (5) Near-zero GTA municipalities (Georgina, Stouffville, Brock, Scugog, East Gwillimbury, Clarington, Caledon) returned 0 / null across tools and were sometimes dropped from tool responses entirely (zero-volume rows are omitted by Ahrefs and Semrush) — recorded as consensusVolume 0, GTA mandatory. (6) Intents from Ahrefs were uniformly informational+commercial+local (a few also transactional: Toronto, Victoria) for every city with data; dominant intent recorded as 'commercial+local'.

toolIssues: All three tools returned data. (1) Ahrefs keywords-explorer-overview capped each call at the keywords that had data — for GTA batch it returned 15 of 27 rows and for metro batch 19 of 20; the omitted keywords (caledon, georgetown, georgina, king city, nobleton, stouffville, uxbridge, clarington, east gwillimbury, brock, scugog, quebec city) had no Ahrefs index = treated as null/no data. Ahrefs intents only populated on rows where difficulty was also computed; rows with null difficulty returned an empty intents object {} (still real volume, just no intent classification). Ahrefs CPC is in USD cents (divided by 100 where reported, e.g. 250c=$2.50). (2) DataForSEO (loc 2124 Canada, en) returned clean data; many small-town combos returned null (no keyword in DataForSEO index) which I treat as ~0, not fabricated. (3) Semrush used database 'ca' (Canada) successfully — no fallback to 'us' needed. Semrush DROPS zero/no-data rows entirely from phrase_these output, so caledon/georgetown/georgina/king city/nobleton/stouffville/clarington/east gwillimbury/brock/scugog/quebec city/aurora are absent = no Semrush data. Semrush 'Number of Results' column is unreliable (some rows show 38M-194M = total web results not keyword-specific) so I ignored it. Notable cross-tool disagreement: for Toronto, Semrush ranks 'agency toronto' (480) above bare 'social media marketing toronto' (320), while DataForSEO/Ahrefs rank bare toronto higher (390/250); for the metros Semrush volumes run roughly 1.5-2x higher than DataForSEO/Ahrefs across the board (Semrush tends to inflate).
